title: Will the character jump?
instruction: The rule: jump when the space bar is pressed AND the character is standing on the ground.

items.text: Space bar pressed, character standing on the ground
items.why: Both parts of the condition are true.

items.text: Space bar pressed, character in the air
items.why: The second part isn’t true. With “and”, both must be true.

items.text: Space bar not pressed, character standing on the ground
items.why: The first part isn’t true, so there’s no jump.

items.text: Space bar not pressed, character in the air
The player holds the space bar and the character has just landed
items.why: Now it is standing on the ground and the space bar is pressed, so it jumps again.

debrief: With AND, both parts must be true. One is not enough, and that’s why the character doesn’t jump in the air.
